segment.source: Renders an excerpt from a longer customer story with the customer's mark above it and a link to read the whole thing. Use it for: teasing a case study from the homepage, closing a solution page with a named reference, an entry point into a customer library. Prefer 'Case Study Teaser' when the numbers matter more than the sentence, and 'Single Testimonial' when there is no longer story behind the quote to link to.
